learner.name: young female clinician
learner.description: East Asian woman in her twenties with a ponytail, wearing teal scrubs and a plain white coat

mentor.name: senior male clinician
mentor.description: East Asian man in his forties with short black hair and thin glasses, wearing navy scrubs and a plain white coat

station.description: Bright modern clinical team room with soft daylight and a wooden desk

shots.visual_prompt: The young female clinician on the left holds a clipboard and presents calmly while the senior male clinician on the right listens and nods attentively
shots.camera_motion: Steady medium two-shot, keeping the 180-degree camera axis locked
shots.dialogue: 大家好，今天我們用一分鐘的時間，帶大家掌握結構化交班的四個核心步驟。
shots.subtitle_text: 今天帶大家掌握結構化交班的四個核心步驟

shots.visual_prompt: Continuing in the same room and screen positions, the female clinician on the left points to the key section on the clipboard while the senior clinician on the right nods in agreement
shots.camera_motion: Very slow push-in to a medium close two-shot
shots.dialogue: 第一步是說明目前狀況與關鍵背景，讓接手團隊在最短時間內抓到重點。
shots.subtitle_text: 第一步：說明目前狀況與關鍵背景，讓團隊快速抓到重點

shots.visual_prompt: The female clinician on the left gestures two clear points with a composed expression while the senior clinician on the right takes notes and smiles
shots.camera_motion: Steady medium two-shot with consistent lighting and background
shots.dialogue: 第二步是提出精準評估與具體建議，明確告訴團隊接下來需要配合的處置方向。
shots.subtitle_text: 第二步：提出精準評估與具體建議，明確說明處置方向

shots.visual_prompt: Both clinicians finish the handoff; the female clinician closes the clipboard and both smile naturally toward the camera
shots.camera_motion: Steady medium two-shot holding the final pose cleanly
shots.dialogue: 掌握結構、穩定表達，就能讓每一次團隊溝通既安全又高效率！
shots.subtitle_text: 掌握結構、穩定表達，讓團隊溝通既安全又高效率！
